LESSON: EXTENSIVE READING: LIBRARY SKILLS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Reading 2.7 Reading Comprehension (2 sessions) • Vocabulary building-parts of th
Topic 2.9: Extensive Reading: Library Skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Extensive Reading: Library Skills, part of Reading 2.7 Reading Comprehension (2 sessions) • Vocabulary building-parts of th in Grade 5 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How can we make reading texts enjoyable?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. team up to identify simple texts to read for enjoyment,

2. collaborate with peers to create an Arabic mini-library for Library sessions,

3. conduct a reader’s theatre to read Arabic texts with peers,

4. create a reading log (with details such as title, author, characters, key events) to track and monitor reading progress,

5. team up with peers to hold book club sessions to discuss Arabic stories read. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. team up to identify simple texts to read for enjoyment,
2. collaborate with peers to create an Arabic mini-library for Library sessions,
3. conduct a reader’s theatre to read Arabic texts with peers,
4. create a reading log (with details such as title, author, characters, key events) to track and monitor reading progress,
5. team up with peers to hold book club sessions to discuss Arabic stories read. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Extensive Reading: Library Skills together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: This is promoted as the learner accumulates information on various themes when participating in book club

sessions to discuss Arabic stories read.

• Learning to learn: This is promoted as the learner engages in collective learning when collaborating with peers to create an

Arabic mini-library for Library sessions.

Values:
Unity: This is nurtured as the learner cooperates with peers to identify simple texts to read for enjoyment.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Nationalism: This is addressed as the learner embraces peers and their unique qualities by working together to build a collection

of Arabic texts and hold book club sessions to promote a reading culture.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept on reading for leisure to their learning in English and Kiswahili.
